name: Prep Closet Shelf Surfaces
intent: Inspect shelf runs, sand per substrate_state, dust, and tack in preparation for primer or finish. Sanding grit and time scale with quality_tier via qt_scaled modifier. Bare wood gets heavier sand than primed; melamine requires deglosser + abrasion for bonding primer adhesion.
doctrine: Sand at 80 LF/hr is a baseline for QT3 bare wood; QT4/QT5 apply qt_scaled slowdown via modifier. Degloss task only fires on melamine (SS_FACTORY_FINISH) — mechanical + chemical surface prep for bonding primer.
